records.name: Eastern Visayas
records.summary: This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier, which identified no deviation from the national position material enough to score separately (±0.02); it is therefore assessed at the national score. The attached sources are national-level rather than regional: a country-organisation overview of the national legal picture, a June 2025 report on the killing of an 18-year-old trans woman in a different province (Cagayan), and a national news item on a case in another region (Batangas) that could not be retrieved at fetch time.

records.name: Northern Mindanao
records.summary: This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier, which identified no deviation from the national position material enough to score separately (±0.02); it is therefore assessed at the national score. The country dossier cautions that this division adjoins a region with significant Muslim populations where separate religious personal-law courts operate, so the absence of a regional signal here reflects lack of documentation rather than confirmed absence of divergence. The attached sources are national-level rather than regional: a country-organisation overview of the national legal picture, a June 2025 report on the killing of an 18-year-old trans woman in a different province (Cagayan), and a national news item on a case in another region (Batangas) that could not be retrieved at fetch time.
